fusions.name: Split-Tail Snap
fusions.desc: Flicks the tip at the first enemy in line, dealing 7 damage; it then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Lashes 2 tails out in a wide split to 8 tiles; each deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Doubled Back
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: When you strike, a second tail branches off and deals 5 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 3 seconds.
